file_purpose: Evidence and gap-tracking profile for Glasgow A100. This file records official University of Glasgow evidence, published admissions statistics, unknowns and prediction-readiness blockers. It is not the production admissions rules file.

metadata.notes: Official University of Glasgow evidence and verified contextual and international UCAT evidence are implemented. Historical interview guidance is active; deterministic current-cycle and offer prediction remain blocked because live applicant-pool thresholds and the interview scoring rubric are unavailable.

readiness.summary: Glasgow A100 supports official-evidence eligibility checks and medium-confidence interview guidance from official UCAT ranking plus historical applicant-group thresholds. Final offers are ranked solely by annually scaled interview performance, but

applicant_groups.name: International / EU applicants
applicant_groups.evidence: International applicants form a separate ranking pool, compete only with other international applicants and have their own threshold and interview quota.

applicant_groups.name: Graduate applicants
applicant_groups.evidence: The degree page states graduate applications to Medicine are considered if the published degree and subject recency conditions are met.

applicant_groups.name: Contextual / widening participation applicants
applicant_groups.evidence: Glasgow publishes adjusted entry requirements for eligible Scotland-domiciled widening participation applicants and identifies Reach as the relevant pre-entry programme for Medicine.

gcse.standard_uk_a_level: GCSE English Literature or English Language at Grade B/6. GCSE Biology at Grade B/6 if Biology is not studied at A-level.
gcse.international_a_level: IGCSE English Literature or English Language at Grade B/6.

national_5.standard: National 5 English, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry and Physics at grade B or above.

a_level.uk_required_subjects: A-level Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics.
a_level.international_required_subjects: A-level Chemistry, Biology and one of Physics or Mathematics.
a_level.resits: Re-sits or additional time to sit qualifications is not permitted. Required grades and subjects must be obtained at one sitting and at first attempt.

scottish.standard: AAAAB Higher in S5 plus BB Advanced Higher in S6.
scottish.required_subjects: Higher Chemistry, Biology and Physics or Mathematics.
scottish.adjusted: AAABB or AAAAC Higher in S5 plus BC Advanced Higher in S6. C grade cannot be in Chemistry. Successful completion of Reach required.
scottish.restrictions: Higher Application of Maths cannot replace Higher Mathematics or Physics. Highers taken in S4 are not considered towards Higher S5 grade requirements.
scottish.resits: Re-sits or additional time to sit qualifications is not permitted. Required grades and subjects must be obtained at one sitting and at first attempt.

ib.required_subjects: HL Chemistry and Biology; SL Physics or Mathematics at 6, with HL recommended; SL English at 6.
ib.resits: Re-sits or additional time to sit qualifications is not permitted. Required grades and subjects must be obtained at one sitting and at first attempt.

graduate.standard: Minimum 2.1 Honours degree in a relevant science degree obtained within seven years of entry.
graduate.older_or_non_science_degrees: Applicants whose degree is older than seven years or who have a non-science degree require A-level/Scottish Higher Chemistry and A-level/AS-level/Scottish Higher Biology within seven years of entry, with minimum grades AB or AA with AS-level Biology.
graduate.masters_or_phd_compensation: A 2.1 degree older than seven years plus a Masters or PhD in a relevant field obtained within seven years may compensate for not having Higher/A-level Chemistry and Biology.
graduate.ucat: Graduate applicants must complete the UCAT and may be invited for interview.

resits.policy: Re-sits or additional time to sit qualifications is not permitted for the main academic requirements.
resits.extenuating_circumstances: If an applicant has taken longer than the standard period because of extenuating circumstances, an explanation and supporting documentation should be submitted at least six weeks before application. UCAT scores cannot be adjusted or discounted for extenuating circumstances.

english_language.test_validity: Tests must have been taken within 2 years 5 months of the programme start date. Overall and subtest requirements must be met in one test.

ucat_policy.requirement_summary: All applicants must complete UCAT by the deadline in the same year as application. Applicants who have not sat UCAT will not be considered; no exceptions are made.
ucat_policy.selection_model: Applicants who meet academic eligibility are ranked for interview using UCAT cognitive score only. Personal statement and reference are reviewed but are not scored, weighted or used for interview ranking.
ucat_policy.threshold_publication: Glasgow states it will not know 2027 UCAT thresholds until November 2026, and 2027 thresholds will not be published until the cycle is complete in September 2027.
ucat_policy.applicant_group_differences: Lowest total UCAT score considered for interview may vary by applicant group because Glasgow manages Scottish Government and Scottish Funding Council targets, including Home, Rest of UK and International.

contextual_shortlisting.threshold_policy: A lower contextual threshold is applied to the separate contextual group.

sjt.policy: SJT portion of UCAT is not considered.

interview_selection.shortlisting: Applicants who meet minimum academic requirements are ranked for interview by UCAT cognitive score only.
interview_selection.academics_role: Minimum eligibility and screening only; no competitive academic points are applied before UCAT ranking.

work_experience.policy: Hospital or general-practice work experience is not required, but applicants are expected to have explored the realities of a medical career.

interview_selection.ranking_pools: Glasgow ranks Scottish, Rest of UK and International applicants separately. International applicants compete only with other international applicants; exact live-cycle pool sizes and thresholds are unknown until the cycle progresses.

interview_format.timing: Late November 2026 to March 2027 unless otherwise stated.
interview_format.notes: The same two interviewers cover Panel A and Panel B. This is a conversational two-part panel interview, not an MMI. No writing is required and interviewers know only the applicant's name.

offer_selection.interview_score_use: Final decisions are made solely on interview performance. Performance is processed and ranked, with secondary screening to confirm all aspects meet requirements.
offer_selection.offer_timing: Offers are usually processed by the end of March or early April.
offer_selection.post_offer_checks: All offers are subject to satisfactory health and police/PVG checks.

contextual_widening_access.scope: University of Glasgow contextualised admissions are stated for applicants living in Scotland.
contextual_widening_access.medicine_adjusted_requirement: For Medicine, adjusted Scottish entry requirement is AAABB or AAAAC Higher in S5 plus BC Advanced Higher in S6, with C not in Chemistry, and successful completion of Reach.
guaranteed_adjusted_offer_criteria: Live in SIMD decile 1-4 (MD20/40) Scottish postcode area
Estranged from family and living without family support
reach_eligibility: Attend a Western Isles school for Medicine or Veterinary Medicine

historical_admissions_and_ucat.warning: Historical admissions and UCAT threshold data are context only. They must not be used as current-cycle hard cutoffs. Published 2022-2025 UCAT values appear on the legacy four-cognitive-subtest scale where maximum values exceed 2700, so they must not be mixed with the 2027 three-cognitive-subtest scale without explicit modelling.

international_selection_evidence.notes: Historical international interview guidance only. Glasgow has no pre-published fixed UCAT threshold.

historical_contextual_ucat_thresholds.notes: The contextual shortlisting mechanism is verified, but no numeric contextual historical thresholds were supplied. Do not infer them from standard-pool thresholds.

historical_interview_score_context.notes: FOI score ranges are contextual estimates from historical cohorts. Annual cohort scaling prevents their use as a fixed current-cycle formula, pass mark or offer threshold.

official_formula_status.notes: The process is UCAT-ranked after screening and interview-only after interview. Annual cohort scaling and undisclosed numerical marking details prevent deterministic prediction; FOI ranges are historical guidance only.

unresolved_gaps.description: Glasgow states 2027 UCAT thresholds are unknown until November 2026 and not published until September 2027 after the cycle.
Interview format is official, but score scale and rubric are not published in the reviewed official evidence.
unresolved_gaps.notes: FOI confirms annual cohort scaling and historical score ranges, but not the exact numerical rubric, maximum or fixed pass mark.

unresolved_gaps.description: Final decisions are interview-only and scores are scaled annually, but the exact scaling calculation and conversion from raw marks to cohort rank are undisclosed.
FOI confirms internal review of attribute consistency for identical interview scores, but the complete tie-break sequence is not published.
BTEC, Access to HE, T-level and other non-standard UK qualification handling for A100 has not been extracted from official Glasgow sources in this pass.
Applicant groups are evidenced, but fixed future quotas/capacity by Scottish, RUK and International groups are not stored.

notes: Glasgow should not be marked prediction-ready from this research file alone.
